Wavee theme 4 · working name Zune Fluent · proposed name Panorama

Zune structure, WinUI style

Every region, page layout and navigation model comes from the Zune theme. Every colour, type style, radius, control and material comes from the WinUI theme, one to one from its token board. This theme owns only the translation: which Fluent role renders each Zune element.

Structure

shared with the Zune theme
  • Frame order: title bar → pivot band → page → inline right panel → play bar at the bottom
  • Navigation: row 1 sections (Home, Browse, Library, Recents), row 2 sub-pivots, or the entity's context tabs; pins in the band; no sidebar
  • Page layouts: panorama columns for entities, the quickplay home, collection columns (artists · albums · songs)
  • The number column and its position, the play bar's three groups and full-width seek
  • Right panel tabs (Queue, Lyrics, Details), inline at 1000 px and wider, overlay below
  • Breakpoints and tiers, full-screen faces

Style

shared with the WinUI theme
  • Every token: layers, fills, strokes, text 1 · 2 · 3 · disabled, accent, status, dark and light
  • Segoe UI Variable and the WinUI type ramp (Caption 12 to Display 68)
  • ControlCornerRadius 4, OverlayCornerRadius 8, the 4 px spacing grid, 36 px page inset
  • Controls: Accent, standard and subtle Button, ToggleButton, Slider, ToggleSwitch, AutoSuggestBox, SelectorBar, ListView backplate + pill, InfoBar, ContentDialog, MenuFlyout, ProgressRing
  • Materials: Mica base, one content layer, acrylic flyouts; Fluent icons at stroke 1

Translation

the only thing this theme owns
  • A role map: each structural role (PanoramaTitle, PivotPrimary, PivotSecondary, TrackNumber, PrimaryAction, SecondaryAction, RowBackplate, SeekBar, PaneSurface) names a WinUI style
  • Casing policy: sentence case, lowercase navigation as an option
  • Size picks inside the ramp: panorama 68, pivots 28, numbers 20 / 28 at Regular
  • Accent policy: where the accent may appear
  • Its options: accent, backdrop, casing, title size, numbers, density, panel
